name: Militia Ore Loop 2
about: The ore loop (factory-generator.md phase 1): Militia Extraction Post 2 over a deposit, Militia Refinery 2 downstream on the same road line, an Ore Hauler under the post's loading auger. Flip LOAD on the auger's post, drive east along the road to the refinery's Tipping Grate (the grate on your left, your left wheels along its edge) and flip TIP behind the cab.

bodies.note: over the deposit, its drills along the back edge
its bed's middle, facing east, under the loading auger's spout
